mechanics.claim: Each time Kassadin (or a nearby champion) casts an ability, Force Pulse's current cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds.
mechanics.quote: Each time '''Kassadin''' or a nearby {{tip|champion}} casts an [[champion ability|ability]], ''Force Pulse's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.75}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Force Pulse also slows enemies hit for 1 second; a slow does not change damage against a stationary target that never repositions.
